criteria.text: The participant has a histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) (squamous and nonsquamous) with Stage IIIB/IIIC or Stage IV disease.

source.text: Participants must have a histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) (squamous and nonsquamous) with Stage IIIB/IIIC or Stage IV disease.

criteria.text: The participant has a programmed death ligand-1 (PD-L1) expression ≥ 50%.

source.text: Participants must have a programmed death ligand-1 (PD-L1) expression ≥ 50%.

criteria.text: The participant has measurable disease as defined by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.

source.text: Participants must have measurable disease as defined by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.

criteria.text: The participant has no prior systemic anti-tumor therapy for locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC.

source.text: Participants must have no prior systemic anti-tumor therapy for locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC.

criteria.text: The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status 0-1.

source.text: Participants must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status 0-1.

criteria.text: The participant has any documented actionable genomic alteration (AGA) for which first-line (1L) approved therapies are indicated.

source.text: Participants must not have any documented actionable genomic alteration (AGA) for which first-line (1L) approved therapies are indicated.

criteria.text: The participant has any symptomatic untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases, leptomeningeal metastases (carcinomatous meningitis) or spinal cord compression.

source.text: Participants must not have any symptomatic untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastases, leptomeningeal metastases (carcinomatous meningitis) or spinal cord compression.

criteria.text: The participant has any significant cardiovascular impairment as evidenced by uncontrolled hypertension (despite optimal medical treatment), congestive heart failure, active coronary disease (within 6 months prior to randomization), ventricular arrhythmias, or major thrombotic or embolic events or major hemorrhagic events (within 6 months prior to randomization), or significant risk of pulmonary hemorrhage.
